summary: More community.general deprecations: installp (use ibm.power_aix.installp), layman, the loganalytics callback (use loganalytics_ingestion), Monit 5.18 and older, pfexec wrap_exe default changing to true, and puppet timeout.
questions: Why do I get a wrap_exe deprecation warning with pfexec?

answer_card.title: community.general deprecations (14.0.0, part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `installp` → **`ibm.power_aix.installp`** (removed in 15.0.0).
- `layman`: removed in 14.0.0 (Gentoo deprecated it).
- `loganalytics` callback → **`community.general.loganalytics_ingestion`** due to Azure Monitor API changes.
- `monit`: Monit 5.18 or older removed in 14.0.0.
- `pfexec` become plugin: `wrap_exe` default changes from `false` to **`true`** in 14.0.0; set it explicitly to silence the warning.
- `puppet`: `timeout` removed in 14.0.0.
